title: Estimate a Bernoulli success probability
description: You connect the sample mean, information estimate, and likelihood curve.

steps.description: You sample 200 binary outcomes with success probability 0.63. Their mean p_hat is the maximum-likelihood estimate.
You compute observed information at p_hat and pass it to wald_ci. The recording reports p_hat=0.670 with standard error about 0.0332.

steps.question: Which counts weight the two log terms in this likelihood?
steps.answer: x.sum() weights log(p) for successes. n-x.sum() weights log(1-p) for failures.

steps.description: You evaluate the likelihood on 300 candidate probabilities and mark the estimate and true probability. The recorded interval is (0.605,0.735).
